analysis.bootstrap: 10000 task-cluster paired draws stratified by family

calibration_method: three concurrent measurements per tool outside episodes
change_reason: Automatic stage progression after complete verified development; no test-result parameter tuning
prompt: You are participating in a local decision experiment. Return exactly one JSON object as your final response. Choose either {"type":"tool","name":"...","arguments":{...}} or {"type":"submit","answer":{"value":number,"evidence_ids":["..."]}}. Use only the experiment tools described in the observation, by requesting a JSON action; never execute tools yourself. The host executes them and returns results in history. Submit only when you have the required answer and evidence. evidence_ids must be the exact set of distinct source IDs supporting the requested result, without extra or duplicate IDs. For a join, include only rows surviving both the join and the requested filters; exclude inspected rows with no qualifying match. There are no other resources or tools available. A duration reference is based on past observations and does not guarantee future duration. Do not output explanations, Markdown or multiple actions.
protocol: one text JSON action; no native/external tool execution
quality_policy: go_quality_v2; both-phase same-tool observation descriptive; primary variability pooled by model

readiness_evidence.primary: fast_to_slow C-B deadline success, paired task-cluster bootstrap

public_answer_audit.method: derive answers and source selection from public questions/data only; no model evaluation or test-set tuning

search.description: 搜索文档摘要，每次最多返回 5 条；可查询实体名，也可查询“档案”浏览档案摘要。摘要不包含档案全文；需用 read_document 读取详细内容。

calculate.description: 计算仅含数字和 + - * / 的表达式

arguments.cursor: 可选，默认为 0；后续页面使用上次返回的 next_cursor

lookup_rows.description: 查询表格行，最多2行；空 filters 查询全部行（分页返回）。products 字段为 id, product, unit_cost, category；batches 字段为 id, product, quantity, status, discount, freight。 如 next_cursor 不为 null，使用同一 table 和 filters 并传入 cursor 获取下一页。
